hooks.name: evidence-gate-check
hooks.description: Re-check the evidence gate when CasePack, evidence or gate files change

action.prompt: CasePack, evidence or gate code changed. For every verdict marked as passed, confirm that it has an official URL in the original language, a clause anchor and an original-language excerpt that match one to one, and that the evidence row has verified_opened true. A translation must never count as evidence. Any verdict that fails is blocked (✕) and shown as unconfirmed. Run the gate tests and report failures with case ids.
